changes: Demoted Authority receipt refs from local productionDone eligibility, restored checker_error/overall proof diagnostics, and documented the host-neutral proof-admissibility boundary.
usage: Use the existing Lattice proof-admissibility smokes and gap_analyze; local CLI evidence may consume Authority receipt refs as evidence/input but not as production completion.
expectedOutcome: The local CLI no longer treats Authority receipt refs as production completion, checker failures are visible as overall=error, and proof-admissibility gaps stay at zero high.
actualTranscript: npm build and proof-admissibility smokes passed; gap_analyze reported 0 high gaps and 1 unrelated medium annotation gap; four reviewer lanes and delivery reviewer passed.
outcomeDiff: No difference between expected and observed story-scoped outcome; global convergence remains outside scope because other active stories exist.
limitations: Full Authority production completion remains external/future adapter scope; this story deliberately does not implement Authority server production receipts.
pitfalls: A concurrent/older host repeatedly committed minimized diffs that removed checker_error/overall semantics; guard session and revert commits were needed before review could proceed.
